Low poly models and sounds in this folder are by Kenney (www.kenney.nl).
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0) - free to use in any project, no credit required.
Credit is still given here because it is the right thing to do.

Packs used (downloaded 2026-10-01 from kenney.nl):
- City Kit (Commercial) 2.1   -> CityCommercial
- City Kit (Suburban) 2.0     -> CitySuburban
- City Kit (Roads)            -> CityRoads (props only)
- Car Kit                     -> Cars
- Mini Characters             -> Characters (includes walk / idle / sprint / die animations)
- Food Kit                    -> Food
- Nature Kit                  -> Nature
- Furniture Kit               -> Furniture
- UI Audio                    -> Audio/UI
- Impact Sounds               -> Audio/Impacts
